title: Data Strategy Catalogue
description: Catalogue of strategic statements for the Data architecture domain — the what and why at the highest level (outcomes, drivers, target states). Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Vision concepts with OKR-style target outcomes.

meta.description: A catalogue of strategic goals and direction for the Data domain.
purpose: Establishes data as a strategic asset with explicit organisational intent behind it
Aligns data investment with business outcomes rather than technical preferences
Provides the 'why' behind data governance, quality, and architecture decisions
Creates accountability for data outcomes at the executive level
Anchors all Data architecture decisions to a traceable set of intentions

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

statement.description: Strategic statement — outcome-oriented, time-bound where appropriate

driver.description: Business driver or external force motivating this strategy

target-outcome.description: Measurable success criterion (what does success look like?)
